nodes.description: Mapping from address to token balance; debited in _transfer and credited on receipt, set in constructor.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount of approved allowances; written by _approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply, computed in the constructor as 10000 * (10 ** _decimals).
Deployer-controlled owner address that receives the entire initial supply.
Token name string set once in the constructor.
Token symbol string set once in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor and used to compute the total supply.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, owner, total supply and the owner balance.
View getter returning the token name.
View getter returning the token symbol.
View getter returning the token decimals.
View getter returning the total supply.
View getter returning the balance of a given account.
External transfer that spends msg.sender funds by delegating to _transfer.
View getter returning the allowance granted by owner to spender.
Sets an allowance for spender using msg.sender as the owner.
Spends an approved allowance: checks allowance, transfers funds and decrements the allowance.
Internal transfer routine with zero-address and balance checks that mutates both balances.
Internal allowance routine with zero-address checks that writes the allowance mapping.
Caller-controlled address used as sender/owner/spender in transfer, approve and transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction _balances[sender] -= amount in _transfer; compiled with pragma ^0.6.0 so no automatic overflow guard.
Unchecked allowance decrement _allowances[sender][msg.sender] -= amount performed inline in transferFrom.
Unchecked addition _balances[recipient] += amount in _transfer, which can wrap on overflow.
Exponentiation/multiplication 10000 * (10 ** _decimals) computing the total supply in the constructor.
Address parameter sender of _transfer, used as the balance debit index.
Address parameter recipient of _transfer, used as the balance credit index.
Amount parameter of _transfer, used in the balance subtraction and addition.
Address parameter sender of transferFrom supplying the allowance owner.
Address parameter recipient of transferFrom receiving the transferred funds.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used by the allowance check and decrement.
Address parameter recipient of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer forwarded to _transfer.
Address parameter spender of approve.
Amount parameter of approve forwarded to _approve.
Address parameter owner of _approve indexing the allowance mapping.
Address parameter spender of _approve indexing the allowance mapping.
Amount parameter of _approve written into the allowance mapping.
Address parameter account of balanceOf used as the mapping lookup key.
Address parameter owner of allowance used as the outer mapping key.
Address parameter spender of allowance used as the inner mapping key.

edges.reason: transfer() uses msg.sender as the true sender address passed into _transfer.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner in _approve.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance check and decrement.
msg.sender indexes the nested allowance mapping that is decremented with unchecked subtraction.
transfer() delegates the balance mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
approve() delegates allowance writing to the internal _approve routine.
transferFrom() invokes _transfer to move the approved funds.
transferFrom() invokes _approve to update the remaining allowance.
transferFrom() performs the inline unchecked allowance subtraction on _allowances.
_transfer debits the sender balance with the unchecked statement _balances[sender] -= amount.
_transfer credits the recipient balance with the unchecked statement _balances[recipient] += amount.
_approve writes the allowance value that transferFrom later decrements without SafeMath.
The constructor computes the supply using exponentiation and multiplication of _decimals.
The computed 10000 * (10 ** _decimals) value is stored into _totalSupply.
The constructor hard-codes and stores the _owner address.
The constructor assigns the whole supply to _balances[_owner].
The unchecked subtraction mutates the _balances mapping entry for the sender.
The unchecked addition mutates the _balances mapping entry for the recipient.
The unchecked decrement mutates the _allowances mapping entry for sender/spender.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals() returns the _decimals state variable.
allowance() reads the _allowances mapping.
The sender parameter indexes the balance entry that is subtracted from.
The recipient parameter indexes the balance entry that is added to.
The amount parameter is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction.
The amount parameter supplied by the caller is the operand of the unchecked allowance decrement.
The recipient parameter of transfer() is forwarded to _transfer.
The amount parameter of transfer() is forwarded to _transfer.
The spender parameter of approve() is forwarded to _approve.
The amount parameter of approve() is forwarded to _approve.
The sender parameter of transferFrom() is used for the allowance and transfer lookups.
The recipient parameter of transferFrom() is forwarded to _transfer.
The owner parameter of _approve indexes the allowance mapping.
The spender parameter of _approve indexes the allowance mapping.
The amount parameter of _approve is written into the allowance mapping.
The account parameter of balanceOf is the mapping lookup key.
The owner parameter of allowance is the outer mapping key.
The spender parameter of allowance is the inner mapping key.

The amount parameter is consumed as the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction.
The sender parameter is only used for the allowance lookup and transfer delegation inside transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is only forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom.
The amount parameter is the operand of the unchecked allowance decrement in transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is a pass-through argument of transfer.
The amount parameter is a pass-through argument of transfer.
The spender parameter is a pass-through argument of approve.
The amount parameter is a pass-through argument of approve.
The owner parameter only indexes the allowance mapping inside _approve.
The spender parameter only indexes the allowance mapping inside _approve.
The amount parameter is directly stored into the allowance mapping by _approve.
